name: KeywordPilot SEO
author: SACHINRAJ CP

sections.description:
KeywordPilot SEO is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that helps you manage SEO keywords for all your content. Perfect for bloggers, marketers, and businesses looking to improve their search engine visibility.

Key Features:

  • Clean, minimal interface that integrates with WordPress
  • Unlimited keywords for posts and pages
  • Works with all standard post types
  • Automatically outputs keywords in meta tags
  • Simple comma-separated keyword input
  • Lightweight with no performance impact
  • Translation ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/keywordpilot-seo/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. When editing any post or page, you’ll see the KeywordPilot SEO meta box.
  4. Enter your keywords, separated by commas.
sections.faq:
Where do I enter keywords?

Keywords can be added in the KeywordPilot SEO meta box that appears when editing any post or page.

How many keywords can I add?

You can add unlimited keywords, separated by commas.

Where are the keywords displayed?

Keywords are automatically added to the <head> section of your pages as meta tags.

Does this work with custom post types?

Yes, it automatically works with all public post types.
